description: This file defines a React functional component 'RoleCard' used to render an interactive card UI element representing a role, along with a 'SkeletonCard' component for loading placeholders. It includes local state management for hover and selection effects, UI styling, and integration of subcomponents like 'CompatibilityScore'.

methods.name: RoleCard
methods.description: React functional component that renders a role card with hover and selection interactions, displaying role details and a button to select as target role.

methods.name: SkeletonCard
methods.description: React functional component that renders a placeholder skeleton card for loading states.
